curriculum.summary: Art for Kids Hub is a family drawing channel run by Rob Jensen with his wife Teryn and their children, who draw step by step on screen. The site says it has over 3,000 lessons, grouped by topic such as animals, buildings, characters and vehicles. Lessons are free on YouTube and the website, supported by ads, and an ad-free membership is offered.

fees_note: Free on YouTube and the website (with ads). Ad-free membership at artforkidshub.tv from US$5.99 a month, with a 7-day free trial (per the site).
